approach: Reference architecture outline for Asynchronous Job Processing Service: Design a service that accepts jobs, processes them concurrently, and tracks their status.

implementation_steps: Implement and test: Async request boundary and job lifecycle state..
Implement and test: Bounded queues and concurrency limits..
Implement and test: Persistent state and transaction-safe updates..
Implement and test: Graceful shutdown, diagnostics, and integration tests..
stretch_features: Add metrics and a recovery simulation.
reference_outline.quality_gate: Run cargo fmt, cargo clippy, cargo test, and relevant integration/target tests in a clean environment before reviewing for publication.

review_checklist: Verify each required feature against the 100-point rubric.
Run relevant tests on the declared stable toolchain and target.
Review security, ownership, external service failure, and shutdown paths.
Do not publish this solution outline as a complete production implementation without expert review.
